entities.name: UniProt O13856
observations: Exact sequence match to the 361-aa Schizosaccharomyces pombe WD repeat-containing protein C1A6.02.
Contains six annotated WD repeats spanning approximately residues 57-318 and a disordered C-terminal region spanning approximately residues 311-361.
Curated localization is nucleus and nucleolus.
Curated biological-process annotation is ribosomal small subunit biogenesis (GO:0042274).
Sequence-derived properties: molecular weight approximately 39.8 kDa and theoretical pI approximately 4.98.
Pfam scan identifies the WDR55 domain (PF24796.2) at residues 12-311.
